stages.name: Laziness
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to a Dormitory, self Morale recovered per hour <@cc.vdown>-0.1</>, but restores <@cc.vup>+0.2</> Morale per hour to all Operators assigned to that Dormitory (Only the strongest effect of this type takes place)

stages.name: Sleepiness
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to a Dormitory, self Morale recovered per hour <@cc.vdown>-0.1</>, but restores <@cc.vup>+0.25</> Morale per hour to all Operators assigned to that Dormitory (Only the strongest effect of this type takes place)
